proposals.action_title: Launch 1st High-Intent KDP Coloring Book (Bold & Easy style)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'Bold and Easy' minimalist coloring book trend is exploding on TikTok/Amazon. It requires thick lines and simple shapes, which FLUX-schnell (via Together AI/Cloudflare free tiers) generates with 100% precision, avoiding the complex rendering artifacts of detailed coloring books.
proposals.first_action_today: Run a bash script in Termux to call Together AI API, generating 40 thick-lined 'Cozy Hygge Objects' images, and compile them into a print-ready PDF using python-reportlab.

proposals.action_title: Cross-list Coloring Pages as Printable PDFs on Etsy
proposals.why_this_works_now: Digital downloads have 90%+ profit margins and zero shipping issues. Reusing the exact same PDF compiled for KDP as a digital download on Etsy maximizes Hugo's hourly ROI immediately.
proposals.first_action_today: Register the Etsy seller account via Android browser and prepare a single listing template for a 'Pack of 40 Cozy Bold & Easy Printable Coloring Pages'.

proposals.action_title: Programmatic Hexagonal / Isometric Grid Notebooks on KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: No AI image generation needed, bypassing current API bottlenecks. Hexagonal graph paper is highly sought after by organic chemistry students and tabletop RPG map makers. Grid lines are generated 100% mathematically via Python in Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a 30-line Python script using 'matplotlib' or 'reportlab' to output a 120-page hexagonal grid PDF, and design a minimalist typographic cover using HTML-to-Image in Termux.

proposals.action_title: Upload 20 Seamless Pattern Packs for Redbubble Home Decor
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble requires zero upfront listing fees (unlike Etsy). By generating 20 high-quality abstract seamless tiles (using Together AI's FLUX-schnell model with pattern-specific prompts), Hugo can target high-margin items like throw pillows, duvets, and phone cases.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 5 seamless pastel retro patterns via GitHub Actions workflow using Together AI, download them to Termux, and upload them to Redbubble using the mobile web interface.

proposals.action_title: Publish Parametric Desk Organizers on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D users love modularity. By writing basic OpenSCAD scripts directly in Termux, Hugo can generate customizable parametric STL files (e.g., SD card holders, hex-organizers) that do not require complex 3D modeling software skills.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a basic OpenSCAD file for a customizable grid drawer organizer, render the STL using the OpenSCAD CLI in Termux, and create a Cults3D draft listing.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers are constantly looking for affordable UI buttons, icons, and tiled textures. Using Together AI, Hugo can generate sheets of UI assets, slice them programmatically using Python (Pillow), and upload them as a ZIP pack.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a set of 50 fantasy RPG potion bottles and UI icons on a grid, write a Python slicing script in Termux to output individual PNGs, and pack them into a zip file.
